claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the value, noting it is much cheaper than what their dentist charges for the same product.
Many customers say it works well and delivers whiter teeth, often comparing it favorably to store-bought whiteners.
Some reviewers report tooth sensitivity, with a few saying it caused sensitivity they hadn't experienced before.
A few customers question whether they received the genuine product, citing differences from what their dentist supplied.
A small number of reviewers feel it is expensive or less effective than the dentist version.
